event: 2025 ILCA Senior Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: SWE 210343 was represented by DOMACK Adrian.
SWE 222536 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
John Diedrichs (coach of SWE 210343 and SWE 222536) and Robert Strange (coach of SWE 210343 and SWE 222536) attended the hearing as observers.
Charlotte Abadie (Chair of Technical Committee) witnessed the interaction between the boats at the finishing line and gave evidence as a witness.
facts: The wind was 20 knots and there were two-metre waves.
Before the starting signal of race 6, SWE 222536 and SWE 210343 were holding their positions below the starting line, both on starboard tack and below close-hauled.
SWE 210343 then established a leeward overlap on SWE 222536 from clear astern, with 0.5 m lateral distance between the boats.
After the starting signal, SWE 222536 continued sailing below close-hauled, while remaining overlapped to windward of SWE 210343.
SWE 210343 did not luff to close-hauled to start, while maintaining the lateral distance between the two boats and avoided contact with SWE 222536.
Both boats started 10 seconds after the starting signal.
After finishing race 6, SWE 210343 asked SWE 222536 politely as to why SWE 222536 was covering him.

SWE 222536 sailed towards SWE 210343, got hold of the main sheet of SWE 210343, hit the deck of SWE 210343 with his hand and shouted aggressively at SWE 210343, "Do you want to get beaten up" and "you fucking pussy", or words to that effect, in Swedish.
SWE 210343 stayed calm and did not respond to the aggression shown by SWE 222536.
There was no damage or injury, but SWE 210343 continued to feel intimidated.

At the starting line for race 7, when SWE 210343 informed SWE 222536 that he would be protesting SWE 222536, SWE 222536 shouted back, "Don't fucking go leeward to me again", or words to that effect, in Swedish.
SWE 210343 was not acquainted with SWE 222536 before this event.
conclusions: SWE 222536 to windward failed to keep clear of SWE 210343 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.

By breaking RRS 11 and not taking the appropriate penalty, as well as intimidating and threatening violence, SWE 222536 failed to compete in compliance with the principles of sportsmanship and fair play as stated in the RRS Basic Principles. SWE 222536 broke RRS 2.
decision: The international jury considered the allegation to be serious misconduct by SWE 222536, and decided to call a hearing under RRS 69.
